quotes.text: // This test has to be first because the session stores redirect target hosts

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The email view stores the accepted redirect host under the submitted email. It skips a repeated prompt only when that host matches. The first landing cleared this map during reset; the reland removes that assignment, so ordinary view reset retains consent. The manual-configuration test therefore runs before host acceptance. Accepted code keeps a separate resetRedirectAccepted method for tests. This is in-memory view state, not a persistent trust or certificate policy.
title: Account Hub redirect consent is remembered by email and host across view resets
